description: Cardano Wrapped 2026: one wallet's year on Cardano (trading, NFTs, staking, governance, an archetype and ranks) with a link to the shareable card. Opens 1 December 2026; before that the tool answers with the launch date and no card. A wallet can opt out, and then there is no card. The first request for a wallet computes the card, which can take a few seconds.

id.description: The wallet: a $handle, a stake1… address or an addr1… address that has a stake part.

refresh.description: Recompute the card instead of reading the stored one (honoured at most about once an hour per wallet).

name: get_wrapped_card
title: Cardano Wrapped 2026 card
